title: Tax break for Gowanus Green affordable housing, Brooklyn
summary: This approves a property tax exemption for the Gowanus Green A affordable housing project at Block 471, Lot 1 in Brooklyn, under state law covering housing development fund companies. The exemption can last up to 40 years from when it takes effect and depends on the project meeting affordability and regulatory agreement requirements set by the city's housing department. It would end if the property is not built or operated as required.
